angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 537,080 km at 41.24 pc = 0.17 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 24.2456 +/- 0.0121 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 41.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.772 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Nardiello et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 235088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract): 537,080 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.849 +/- 0.009 solar masses from Nardiello et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 235088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5075 +/- 75 K from Nardiello et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 235088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Nardiello et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 235088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-235088.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.592, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): spectral type K V, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.02 dex, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.4437, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): age 0.7 Gyr, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.17 d, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 235088 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.9 km/s, from Nardiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..32N/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.772 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.592. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
